shloka_text: अभिषिक्ते तु काकुत्स्थे धर्मेण विदितात्मनि । व्यतीता या निशा पूर्वा पौराणां हर्षवर्धिनी ।। 7.37.1 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu kākutsthe dharmeṇa viditātmani | vyatītā yā niśā pūrvā paurāṇāṃ harṣavardhinī || 7.37.1 ||
translation: अभिषिक्ते having been consecrated, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थे when Rama, धर्मेण righteously, विदितात्मनि whose soul was known, व्यतीता passed, या which, निशा night, पूर्वा first, पौराणाम् of the citizens, हर्षवर्धिनी increasing joy.
explanation: When Rama, whose soul was known for righteousness, had been consecrated, the first night, which increased the joy of the citizens, passed.
comments: On the first morning after his consecration Rama is awakened by the praises of bards, performs his ablutions and worship, and holds court -- attended by Vasishtha and the ministers, his brothers, the assembled kings, the monkey-chiefs led by Sugriva, and Vibhishana with his rakshasas, he shines amid them like Indra among the gods.

shloka_text: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां प्रातर्नृपतिबोधकाः । वन्दिनः समुपातिष्ठन्सौम्या नृपतिवेश्मनि ।। 7.37.2 ।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ prātarnṛpatibodhakāḥ | vandinaḥ samupātiṣṭhansaumyā nṛpativeśmani || 7.37.2 ||
translation: तस्याम् in that, रजन्याम् night, व्युष्टायाम् having dawned, प्रातः in the morning, नृपतिबोधकाः awakeners of the king, वन्दिनः bards, समुपातिष्ठन् stood near, सौम्याः gentle, नृपतिवेश्मनि in the king's palace.
explanation: As that night dawned, in the morning, gentle bards, who were the awakeners of the king, stood near the king's palace.

shloka_text: ते रक्तकण्ठिनः सर्वे किन्नरा इव शिक्षिताः । तुष्टुवुर्नपतिं वीरं यथावत् सम्प्रहर्षिणः ।। 7.37.3 ।।
transliteration: te raktakaṇṭhinaḥ sarve kinnarā iva śikṣitāḥ | tuṣṭuvurnapatiṃ vīraṃ yathāvat sampraharṣiṇaḥ || 7.37.3 ||
translation: ते they, रक्तकण्ठिनः with melodious voices, सर्वे all, किन्नराः Kinnaras, इव like, शिक्षिताः trained, तुष्टुवुः praised, नृपतिम् the king, वीरम् the hero, यथावत् appropriately, सम्प्रहर्षिणः greatly rejoicing.
explanation: All of them, with melodious voices, trained like Kinnaras, greatly rejoicing, duly praised the heroic king.

shloka_text: वीर सौम्य प्रबुध्यस्व कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन । जगद्धि सर्वं स्वपिति त्वयि सुप्ते नराधिप ।। 7.37.4 ।।
transliteration: vīra saumya prabudhyasva kausalyāprītivardhana | jagaddhi sarvaṃ svapiti tvayi supte narādhipa || 7.37.4 ||
translation: वीर O hero, सौम्य O gentle one, प्रबुध्यस्व wake up, कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन O enhancer of Kausalya's joy, जगत् the world, हि indeed, सर्वम् all, स्वपिति sleeps, त्वयि when you, सुप्ते are asleep, नराधिप O king of men.
explanation: O heroic and gentle king, who increases Kausalya's joy, please awaken, for indeed, when you sleep, the entire world sleeps.

shloka_text: विक्रमस्ते यथा विष्णो रूपं चैवाश्विनोरिव । बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यः प्रजापतिसमो ह्यसि ।। 7.37.5 ।।
transliteration: vikramaste yathā viṣṇo rūpaṃ caivāśvinoriva | buddhyā bṛhaspatestulyaḥ prajāpatisamo hyasi || 7.37.5 ||
translation: विक्रमः valor, ते your, यथा like, विष्णोः of Vishnu, रूपम् form/beauty, च and, एव indeed, अश्विनोः of the Ashvins, इव like, बुद्ध्या in intellect, बृहस्पतेः of Brihaspati, तुल्यः equal, प्रजापतिसमः equal to Prajapati, हि indeed, असि you are.
explanation: Your valor is like that of Vishnu, your beauty is like that of the Ashvins, you are equal to Brihaspati in intellect, and indeed, you are like Prajapati himself.

shloka_text: क्षमा ते पृथिवीतुल्या तेजसा भास्करोपमः । वेगस्ते वायुना तुल्यो गाम्भीर्यमुदधेरिव ।। 7.37.6 ।।
transliteration: kṣamā te pṛthivītulyā tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ | vegaste vāyunā tulyo gāmbhīryamudadheriva || 7.37.6 ||
translation: क्षमा forgiveness/patience, ते your, पृथिवीतुल्या equal to the earth, तेजसा in splendor, भास्करोपमः comparable to the sun, वेगः speed, ते your, वायुना to the wind, तुल्यः equal, गाम्भीर्यम् depth, उदधेः of the ocean, इव like.
explanation: Your patience is like that of the earth, your splendor is comparable to the sun, your speed is equal to the wind, and your depth is like that of the ocean.

shloka_text: अप्रकम्प्यो यता स्थाणुश्चन्द्रे सौम्यत्वमीदृशम् । नेदृशाः पार्थिवाः पूर्वं भवितारो नराधिप ।। 7.37.7 ।।
transliteration: aprakampyo yatā sthāṇuścandre saumyatvamīdṛśam | nedṛśāḥ pārthivāḥ pūrvaṃ bhavitāro narādhipa || 7.37.7 ||
translation: अप्रकम्प्यः unshakable, यथा like, स्थाणुः a pillar, चन्द्रे in the moon, सौम्यत्वम् gentleness, ईदृशम् such, न not, ईदृशाः such, पार्थिवाः kings, पूर्वम् before, भवितारः will be, नराधिप O king of men.
explanation: You are unshakable like a pillar, and possess such gentleness as found in the moon; O king of men, there have been no such kings before, nor will there be in the future.

shloka_text: यथा त्वमतिदुर्धर्षो धर्मनित्यः प्रजाहितः । न त्वां जहाति कीर्तिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च पुरुषर्षभ ।। 7.37.8 ।।
transliteration: yathā tvamatidurdharṣo dharmanityaḥ prajāhitaḥ | na tvāṃ jahāti kīrtiśca lakṣmīśca puruṣarṣabha || 7.37.8 ||
translation: यथा as, त्वम् you, अतिदुर्धर्षः extremely formidable, धर्मनित्यः always righteous, प्रजाहितः devoted to the welfare of the subjects, न not, त्वाम् you, जहाति abandons, कीर्तिः fame, च and, लक्ष्मीः prosperity, च and, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.
explanation: As you are extremely formidable, always righteous, and devoted to the welfare of your subjects, O best among men, neither fame nor prosperity ever abandons you.

shloka_text: श्रीश्च धर्मश्च काकुत्स्थ त्वयि नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ । एताश्चान्याश्च मधुरा वन्दिभिः परिकीर्तिताः ।। 7.37.9 ।।
transliteration: śrīśca dharmaśca kākutstha tvayi nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau | etāścānyāśca madhurā vandibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 7.37.9 ||
translation: श्रीश्च prosperity and, धर्मश्च righteousness and, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha (Rama), त्वयि in you, नित्यं always, प्रतिष्ठितौ are established. एताश्च these and, अन्याश्च other, मधुरा sweet (praises), वन्दिभिः by bards, परिकीर्तिताः were proclaimed.
explanation: O Rama, prosperity and righteousness are eternally established in you, and these and other sweet praises were sung by the bards.

shloka_text: सूताश्च संस्तवैर्दिव्यैर्बोधयन्ति स्म राघवम् । स्तुतिभिः स्तूयमानाभिः प्रत्यबुध्यत राघवः ।। 7.37.10 ।।
transliteration: sūtāśca saṃstavairdivyairbodhayanti sma rāghavam | stutibhiḥ stūyamānābhiḥ pratyabudhyata rāghavaḥ || 7.37.10 ||
translation: सूताश्च and charioteers/bards, संस्तवैः with praises, दिव्यैः divine, बोधयन्ति awakened, स्म (past tense indicator), राघवम् Rama. स्तुतिभिः with praises, स्तूयमानाभिः being sung, प्रत्यबुध्यत awoke, राघवः Rama.
explanation: The bards, with their divine praises, awakened Rama, and Rama awoke to the sound of these eulogies being sung.

shloka_text: स तद्विहाय शयनं पाण्डराच्छादनास्तृतम् । उत्तस्थौ नागशयनाद्धरिर्नारायणो यथा ।। 7.37.11 ।।
transliteration: sa tadvihāya śayanaṃ pāṇḍarācchādanāstṛtam | uttasthau nāgaśayanāddharirnārāyaṇo yathā || 7.37.11 ||
translation: स He, तत् that, विहाय having left, शयनं bed, पाण्डराच्छादनास्तृतम् covered with white sheets, उत्तस्थौ rose up, नागशयनात् from the serpent-bed, हरिः Vishnu, नारायणो Narayana, यथा as.
explanation: He rose from that bed, which was covered with white sheets, just as Lord Narayana (Vishnu) rises from his serpent-bed.

shloka_text: तमुत्थितं महात्मानं प्रह्वाः प्राञ्जलयो नराः । सलिलं भाजनैः शुभ्रैरुपतस्थुः सहस्रशः ।। 7.37.12 ।।
transliteration: tamutthitaṃ mahātmānaṃ prahvāḥ prāñjalayo narāḥ | salilaṃ bhājanaiḥ śubhrairupatasthuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 7.37.12 ||
translation: तम् Him, उत्थितं risen, महात्मानं the great-souled one, प्रह्वाः humble, प्राञ्जलयो with folded hands, नराः men, सलिलं water, भाजनैः with vessels, शुभ्रैः pure/clean, उपतस्थुः approached/offered, सहस्रशः by thousands.
explanation: Thousands of humble men, with folded hands, approached the risen great-souled Rama, offering him water in pure vessels.

shloka_text: कृतोदकशुचिर्भूत्वा काले हुतहुताशनः । देवागारं जगामाशु पुण्यमिक्ष्वाकुसेवितम् ।। 7.37.13 ।।
transliteration: kṛtodakaśucirbhūtvā kāle hutahutāśanaḥ | devāgāraṃ jagāmāśu puṇyamikṣvākusevitam || 7.37.13 ||
translation: कृतोदकशुचिः having performed ablutions and become pure, भूत्वा having become, काले at the proper time, हुतहुताशनः having offered oblations to the fire, देवागारं to the temple, जगाम went, आशु quickly, पुण्यम् sacred, इक्ष्वाकुसेवितम् frequented by the Ikshvakus.
explanation: Having purified himself with ablutions and offered oblations to the sacred fire at the appropriate time, he quickly went to the holy temple, which was traditionally frequented by the Ikshvaku kings.

shloka_text: तत्र देवान्पितऽन्विप्रानर्चयित्वा यथाविधि । बाह्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम जनैर्वृतः ।। 7.37.14 ।।
transliteration: tatra devānpita'nviprānarcayitvā yathāvidhi | bāhyakakṣāntaraṃ rāmo nirjagāma janairvṛtaḥ || 7.37.14 ||
translation: तत्र there, देवान् gods, पितॄन् ancestors, विप्रान् Brahmins, अर्चयित्वा having worshipped, यथाविधि according to custom, बाह्यकक्षान्तरम् to the outer chamber, रामः Rama, निर्जगाम emerged, जनैः by people, वृतः surrounded.
explanation: After duly worshipping the gods, ancestors, and Brahmins, Rama emerged into the outer chamber, surrounded by many people.

shloka_text: उपतस्थुर्महात्मानो मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः । वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः ।। 7.37.15 ।।
transliteration: upatasthurmahātmāno mantriṇaḥ sapurohitāḥ | vasiṣṭhapramukhāḥ sarve dīpyamānā ivāgnayaḥ || 7.37.15 ||
translation: उपतस्थुः approached, महात्मानः great-souled ones, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सपुरोहिताः with their priests, वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः headed by Vasishtha, सर्वे all, दीप्यमानाः shining, इव like, अग्नयः fires.
explanation: All the great-souled ministers, along with their priests and headed by Vasishtha, approached Rama, shining brightly like fires.

shloka_text: क्षत्रियाश्च महात्मानो नानाजनपदेश्वराः । रामस्योपाविशन्पार्श्वे शक्रस्येव यथा ऽमराः ।। 7.37.16 ।।
transliteration: kṣatriyāśca mahātmāno nānājanapadeśvarāḥ | rāmasyopāviśanpārśve śakrasyeva yathā 'marāḥ || 7.37.16 ||
translation: क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, च and, महात्मानः great-souled ones, नानाजनपदेश्वराः rulers of various countries, रामस्य of Rama, उपाविशन् sat near, पार्श्वे at the side, शक्रस्य of Indra, इव like, यथा just as, अमराः immortals.
explanation: Great-souled Kshatriyas and rulers from various regions sat by Rama's side, just as the immortals sit by Indra.

shloka_text: भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चात्र शत्रुघ्नश्च महायशाः । उपासाञ्चक्रिरे हृष्टा वेदास्त्रय इवाध्वरम् ।। 7.37.17 ।।
transliteration: bharato lakṣmaṇaścātra śatrughnaśca mahāyaśāḥ | upāsāñcakrire hṛṣṭā vedāstraya ivādhvaram || 7.37.17 ||
translation: भरतः Bharata, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, च and, अत्र there, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, च and, महायशाः highly renowned, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे attended, हृष्टाः delighted, वेदाः Vedas, त्रयः three, इव like, अध्वरम् a sacrifice.
explanation: There, the highly renowned Bharata, Lakshmana, and Shatrughna attended upon Rama with delight, just as the three Vedas attend upon a sacrifice.

shloka_text: याताः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा किङ्करा मुदिताननाः । मुदिता नाम पार्श्वस्था बहवः समुपाविशन् ।। 7.37.18 ।।
transliteration: yātāḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā kiṅkarā muditānanāḥ | muditā nāma pārśvasthā bahavaḥ samupāviśan || 7.37.18 ||
translation: याताः came, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, किङ्कराः servants, मुदिताननाः with joyful faces, मुदिताः joyful ones, नाम indeed, पार्श्वस्थाः standing by the side, बहवः many, समुपाविशन् sat down together.
explanation: Many servants with joyful faces came with folded hands and, indeed joyful, sat down by his side.

shloka_text: वानराश्च महावीर्या विंशतिः कामरूपिणः । सुग्रीवप्रमुखा राममुपासन्ते महौजसः ।। 7.37.19 ।।
transliteration: vānarāśca mahāvīryā viṃśatiḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ | sugrīvapramukhā rāmamupāsante mahaujasaḥ || 7.37.19 ||
translation: वानराः monkeys, च and, महावीर्याः greatly valorous, विंशतिः twenty, कामरूपिणः assuming any form at will, सुग्रीवप्रमुखाः led by Sugriva, महौजसः greatly powerful, रामम् Rama, उपासन्ते serve.
explanation: Twenty greatly valorous and powerful monkeys, led by Sugriva, who can assume any form at will, serve Rama.

shloka_text: विभीषणश्च रक्षोभिश्चतुर्भिः परिवारितः । उपासते महात्मानं धनेशमिव गुह्यकाः ।। 7.37.20 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhiścaturbhiḥ parivāritaḥ | upāsate mahātmānaṃ dhaneśamiva guhyakāḥ || 7.37.20 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, चतुर्भिः by four, रक्षोभिः rakshasas, परिवारितः surrounded, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Rama), उपासते serve, धनेशम् the lord of wealth (Kubera), गुह्यकाः Guhyakas, इव like.
explanation: And Vibhishana, surrounded by four rakshasas, serves the great-souled Rama, just as Guhyakas serve Kubera, the lord of wealth.

shloka_text: तथा निगमवृद्धाश्च कुलीना ये च मानवाः । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः ।। 7.37.21 ।।
transliteration: tathā nigamavṛddhāśca kulīnā ye ca mānavāḥ | śirasā ' 'vandya rājānamupāsante vicakṣaṇāḥ || 7.37.21 ||
translation: तथा similarly, निगमवृद्धाः elders of the guilds/cities, च and, ये who, कुलीनाः of noble birth, च and, मानवाः men, विचक्षणाः wise, शिरसा with their heads, आवन्द्य having bowed down, राजानम् the king (Rama), उपासन्ते serve.
explanation: Similarly, the wise elders of the guilds and noble-born men serve the king, Rama, having bowed down with their heads.

shloka_text: तथा परिवृतो राजा श्रीमद्भिर्ऋषिभिर्वृतः । राजभिश्च महावीर्यैर्वानरैश्च सराक्षसैः ।। 7.37.22 ।।
transliteration: tathā parivṛto rājā śrīmadbhirṛṣibhirvṛtaḥ | rājabhiśca mahāvīryairvānaraiśca sarākṣasaiḥ || 7.37.22 ||
translation: तथा thus, राजा the king (Rama), श्रीमद्भिः by glorious, ऋषिभिः sages, वृतः surrounded, च and, महावीर्यैः greatly valorous, राजभिः kings, च and, वानरैः monkeys, च and, सराक्षसैः with rakshasas, परिवृतः surrounded.
explanation: Thus, the king Rama is surrounded by glorious sages, greatly valorous kings, monkeys, and rakshasas.

shloka_text: यथा देवेश्वरो नित्यमृषिभिः समुपास्यते । अधिकस्तेन रूपेण सहस्राक्षाद्विरोचते ।। 7.37.23 ।।
transliteration: yathā deveśvaro nityamṛṣibhiḥ samupāsyate | adhikastena rūpeṇa sahasrākṣādvirocate || 7.37.23 ||
translation: यथा just as, देवेश्वरः the lord of gods (Indra), नित्यम् always, ऋषिभिः by sages, समुपास्यते is served, तेन by that, रूपेण in form/splendor, अधिकः superior, सहस्राक्षात् than the thousand-eyed one (Indra), विरोचते shines.
explanation: Just as the lord of gods, Indra, is always served by sages, Rama shines with a splendor superior to that of the thousand-eyed Indra.

shloka_text: तेषां समुपविष्टानां तास्ताः सुमधुराः कथाः । कथ्यन्ते धर्मसंयुक्ताः पुराणज्ञैर्महात्मभिः ।। 7.37.24 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ tāstāḥ sumadhurāḥ kathāḥ | kathyante dharmasaṃyuktāḥ purāṇajñairmahātmabhiḥ || 7.37.24 ||
translation: तेषां of them, समुपविष्टानां who were seated, तास्ताः those various, सुमधुराः very sweet, कथाः stories, कथ्यन्ते are narrated, धर्मसंयुक्ताः endowed with righteousness, पुराणज्ञैः by those who know the Puranas, महात्मभिः by great souls,
explanation: To those who were seated, various very sweet stories imbued with righteousness were narrated by great souls who were learned in the Puranas. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 37 ।। Thus ends the thirty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
